paper_title: Search for axion-like dark matter through nuclear spin precession in electric and magnetic fields
notes: Headline result = first laboratory limit on the axion-gluon coupling (oscillating neutron EDM), Fig.4 top panel (psi_ill_axion_limits_v7.pdf), plotted natively as C_G/f_a [GeV^-1] vs axion mass. Vector paths extracted with pymupdf: red = long time-base (ILL), blue = short time-base (PSI). Excluded region is above both curves; reported curve = lower envelope (min coupling) combining both branches. Axis calibration from tick strokes (17.13 px/decade in mass anchored at x=75.1->1e-24 eV; 11.83 px/decade in coupling anchored at y=308.6->1e-24 GeV^-1); cross-checked: red plateau -> C_G/f_a~1e-21 GeV^-1 i.e. f_a/C_G~1e21 GeV at m<1e-23 eV, matching the paper text. Converted to canonical AxionEDM g_d via the paper Eq.(2) d_n=2.4e-16 (C_G/f_a) a_0 e.cm and d_n=g_d a_0, giving g_d[GeV^-2]=2.4e-16 x (C_G/f_a)[GeV^-1] x (1 e.cm=1.535e13 GeV^-1)=3.683e-3 x (C_G/f_a). The e.cm->GeV^-1 factor includes e=0.303; if the compilation drops the e the values scale up by ~3.3. Density rho_DM^local=0.4 GeV/cm^3 assumed (axions saturate DM); not rescaled per task card. Mass range ~5e-25 to 1.5e-17 eV. 95% C.L.
